records.jp: くっ……何よこれ。あなたたち、私に何かしたの
records.en_original: Ugh... What is this? What did you do to me?
records.en_auxiliary: Ugh... What is this? What did you do to me?
records.en: Ugh... What is this? What did you do to me?

records.jp: 何って
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: Us? But you're the one who—
records.en: What?

records.jp: やっぱり分かってリープさせてるわけじゃないみたい
records.en_original: So she doesn't know that she's triggered the leap.
records.en_auxiliary: It seems she doesn't know that she triggered the leap.
records.en: So it looks like she isn't triggering the leap consciously.

records.jp: 今も無意識にフラグメントの固定を拒絶して、<CR>ライムたちを弾き飛ばした感じ
records.en_original: Just now, she unconsciously refused to let her Fragment be stabilized. That's what sent us back here.
records.en_auxiliary: Just now, she unconsciously refused to let her Fragment be stabilized. That's what sent us back here.
records.en: Just now, she unconsciously resisted having her Fragment stabilized<CR>and knocked Lime and the others away.

records.jp: そんなことできる子がいるんだ。信じられない<CR>……ああ
records.en_original: I can't believe that such a thing is even possible... <CR>Ah!
records.en_auxiliary: I can't believe that such a thing is even possible... Ah!
records.en: I can't believe someone can do that.<CR>...Ah.

records.jp: すごい。<CR>フラグメントのエネルギーが強すぎてまだ空間の歪みが残ってる
records.en_original: Wow. The energy from her Fragment is so strong that I can still feel the space-time distortion here.
records.en_auxiliary: Wow. The energy from her Fragment is so strong that I can still feel the space-time distortion here.
records.en: Amazing.<CR>Her Fragment's energy is so strong that the distortion in space is still lingering.

records.jp: あれ……？　私たち、何してたんだっけ
records.en_original: Huh.....? What were we doing?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...? What were we doing?
records.en: Huh...? What were we doing again?

records.jp: なんか読み合わせの最中に、言い合いになった気がするけど……<CR>ううん？　思い出せない
records.en_original: I vaguely remember getting in an argument during our read-through...... Hmm? It's like my mind's a complete blank.
records.en_auxiliary: I vaguely remember getting in an argument during our read-through... Hmm? It's like my mind's a complete blank.
records.en: I feel like we started arguing during the read-through...<CR>Huh? I can't remember.

records.jp: 記憶が飛んでる？
records.en_original: So they don't remember anything?
records.en_auxiliary: They don't remember anything?
records.en: Have they lost their memories?

records.jp: 歪みの影響が他の人の心にまで及んでる……
records.en_original: Is the distortion affecting other people too...?
records.en_auxiliary: The distortion is affecting other people too...
records.en: The distortion is affecting other people's minds too...

records.jp: 蜷川さん？　どうしたの怖い顔して。<CR>読み合わせ続けないの？
records.en_original: Ninagawa? What's wrong? You have a scary look on your face. Aren't we going to finish our read-through?
records.en_auxiliary: Ninagawa? What's wrong? You have a scary look on your face. Aren't we going to finish our read-through?
records.en: Ninagawa-san? Why the scary look?<CR>Aren't we going to continue the read-through?

records.jp: あれ、司城さんたちも、いつの間に来てたの？
records.en_original: Huh? Shijous? Since when did you arrive?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? The Shijous are here? Since when?
records.en: Huh? Shijou-san and the others? When did you get here?

records.jp: みんな、ちょっといい？　提案があるんだけど
records.en_original: Everyone, can I ask you all a favor?
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone, can I ask you all a favor?
records.en: Everyone, can I have your attention? I have a proposal.

records.jp: 何？
records.en_original: What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: What's up?
records.en: What's up?

records.jp: どうしたの？
records.en_original: Is something wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Is something wrong?
records.en: Is something wrong?

records.jp: 今回の主役、決め直さない？
records.en_original: Would anyone mind if we recast the lead?
records.en_auxiliary: Would anyone mind if we recast the lead?
records.en: Would anyone mind if we recast the lead?

records.jp: ひ、日菜子ちゃん！？<CR>いきなりどうしたの？
records.en_original: Are you sure about this, Hinako!?
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako?! What's going on?
records.en: H-Hinako-chan!?<CR>Why all of a sudden?

records.jp: ごめん、早苗。せっかく推薦してくれたのに
records.en_original: Sorry, Sanae. I really do appreciate you recommending me for the part.
records.en_auxiliary: Sorry, Sanae. I really do appreciate you recommending me for the part.
records.en: Sorry, Sanae. I really do appreciate you recommending me for the part.

records.jp: でも前回の打ち合わせの時、他に候補者がいなかったから<CR>流れで役を決めちゃった気もしてて
records.en_original: But I only ended up taking the role because nobody else volunteered.
records.en_auxiliary: But I only ended up taking the role because nobody else volunteered.
records.en: But at our last meeting, no one else was a candidate,<CR>so I feel like we just went with the flow when assigning the role.

records.jp: 本当に上手くできる人は誰かってところから<CR>考えてもいいと思うんだ
records.en_original: I think we should consider who would actually do the best job in the lead role.
records.en_auxiliary: I think we should consider who would actually do the best job in the lead role.
records.en: I think we should start by considering<CR>who can actually perform the role best.

records.jp: 本当に上手くできる人……？
records.en_original: The best job...?
records.en_auxiliary: The best job...?
records.en: The best job...?

records.jp: 麻央、私と主役の座を賭けてオーディションしてみない？
records.en_original: Say, Mao, why don't we hold an audition for the lead role? Just you and me.
records.en_auxiliary: Say, Mao, why don't we hold an audition for the lead role? Just you and me.
records.en: Say, Mao, why don't we hold an audition for the lead role? Just you and me.

records.jp: あなた……どういうつもり？
records.en_original: ...What are you on about?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What are you on about?
records.en: What are you trying to do?

records.jp: 麻央ってプロの女優だよね。だったら私より<CR>ずっと上手く演技ができると思う
records.en_original: You are a professional actress, aren't you? I bet you could act circles around me.
records.en_auxiliary: You are a professional actress, aren't you? I bet you could act circles around me.
records.en: Mao, you're a professional actress, right?<CR>Then I think you can act far better than I can.

records.jp: 主役には適任だと思うけど
records.en_original: I think you're the best fit for the role.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you're the best fit for the role.
records.en: I think you're the best fit for the role.

records.jp: 私に、こんなおままごとに付き合えっていうの？<CR>馬鹿馬鹿しい、ごめんだわ
records.en_original: Are you asking me to play along with your little game? I wasn't born yesterday, thanks.
records.en_auxiliary: Are you asking me to play along with your little game? I wasn't born yesterday, thanks.
records.en: You're telling me to take part in this childish game?<CR>Ridiculous. No thanks.

records.jp: 自信がないの？
records.en_original: So you don't have the guts?
records.en_auxiliary: So you don't have the guts?
records.en: Aren't you confident?

records.jp: なんですって？
records.en_original: What did you say?
records.en_auxiliary: What did you say?
records.en: What did you say?

records.jp: おままごとで、しかも素人相手の勝負を怖がってるの？<CR>って聞いたの
records.en_original: I'm asking you if you're too scared to compete against a total amateur like me.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm asking you if you're too scared to compete against a total amateur like me.
records.en: I'm asking whether you're afraid to compete in this childish game<CR>against an amateur like me.

records.jp: 負けるのが嫌だから逃げてるんじゃない？
records.en_original: Or is the idea of losing so scary that you're running away from it.
records.en_auxiliary: Or is the idea of losing so scary that you're running away?
records.en: Aren't you running away because you don't want to lose?

records.jp: あなた、言葉には気をつけなさいよ。<CR>誰が誰から逃げてるですって？
records.en_original: Watch your mouth. Who's running away from who here?
records.en_auxiliary: Watch your mouth. Who's running away from who here?
records.en: Watch your words.<CR>Who exactly is running away from whom?

records.jp: 私があなたを恐がってるとでも？
records.en_original: What, you think I'm scared of you.
records.en_auxiliary: What, you think I'm scared of you?
records.en: Do you really think I'm afraid of you?

records.jp: ううん。ごめん、私は麻央は逃げないって信じてるよ。<CR>特に「演技」に関わることからは絶対
records.en_original: Not at all. Sorry, I know you won't run away, Mao. Especially from a chance to act.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. Sorry, I know you won't run away, Mao. Especially from a chance to act.
records.en: No. Sorry. I believe you won't run away, Mao.<CR>Especially not from anything involving acting.

records.jp: わかった。じゃあもう一つ条件を出すよ
records.en_original: Alright, then. Looks like I have to sweeten the pot.
records.en_auxiliary: All right, then. Looks like I have to sweeten the deal.
records.en: All right. Then I'll add one more condition.

records.jp: もし私が負けたら麻央が嫌がることは金輪際しない。<CR>正義の味方ごっこはやめるよ
records.en_original: If you beat me, I won't do anything to upset you anymore. No more parading around as Little Miss Justice.
records.en_auxiliary: If you beat me, I won't do anything to upset you anymore. No more parading around as Little Miss Justice.
records.en: If I lose, I'll never do anything you don't want me to do again.<CR>I'll stop playing the hero.

records.jp: その言葉、後で取り消さないわね？
records.en_original: You're sure you won't take that back?
records.en_auxiliary: You're sure you won't take that back?
records.en: You're sure you won't take that back?

records.jp: うん。約束する
records.en_original: Of course. I promise.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. I promise.
records.en: Of course. I promise.

records.jp: ……後悔するわよ
records.en_original: ...You're going to regret that.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're going to regret it.
records.en: ...You're going to regret that.

records.jp: いいんじゃない、オーディション。<CR>白井さんが言うことだし、やってみましょうか
records.en_original: All right then, an audition it is. If Shirai's that dead set on having one, we might as well.
records.en_auxiliary: All right then, an audition it is. If Shirai's that dead set on having one, we might as well.
records.en: An audition sounds fine.<CR>If Shirai-san is the one proposing it, why don't we try?

records.jp: うーん。確かに、今回の配役、えいやで決まっちゃった<CR>部分もあったし、いいのかな？
records.en_original: Hmm. I guess we did kind of cast the lead role on a whim, so I guess it isn't a bad idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. We did kinda cast the lead role on a whim, so I guess it isn't a bad idea.
records.en: Hmm. We did decide the current cast rather impulsively,<CR>so I guess it should be fine.

records.jp: 蜷川さんだって十分舞台映えするものね。<CR>ていうか本職だし、そっちのほうが人呼べるかも
records.en_original: Ninagawa would probably shine on stage too. I mean, she IS a professional, so more people might come to watch.
records.en_auxiliary: Ninagawa would probably shine on stage, too. I mean, she IS a professional, so more people might come to watch.
records.en: Ninagawa-san would look good on stage too.<CR>She's a professional, so she might draw a bigger crowd.

records.jp: さっきの白井さんの演技も悪くなかったし、<CR>白井さんと蜷川さんのどっちかでいいんじゃない
records.en_original: Shirai's acting during the read-through was good, though, so why don't we decide between her and Ninagawa-san?
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai's acting during the read-through was good, though, so why don't we decide between her and Ninagawa?
records.en: Shirai-san's acting during the read-through wasn't bad either,<CR>so why don't we decide between her and Ninagawa-san?

records.jp: ……決まりだね。じゃあ、次回の会議で決めよう。<CR>今日は解散で
records.en_original: ...Then we have a plan. We'll make our decision at the next meeting. For now, let's call it a day.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Then it's settled. We'll make our decision at the next meeting. For now, let's call it a day.
records.en: ...Then it's settled. We'll decide at the next meeting.<CR>That's all for today.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、どうしてあんなこと！
records.en_original: Hina! What that all about!?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina! What was that all about?!
records.en: Hina-chan, why did you do that!?

records.jp: チャンスを与えてやるような相手じゃないのに
records.en_original: People like her don't deserve second chances.
records.en_auxiliary: People like her don't deserve second chances.
records.en: She isn't someone you should give a chance to.

records.jp: 私、麻央のことをもっと知りたいんだ
records.en_original: I want to get to know Mao better.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to get to know Mao better.
records.en: I want to get to know Mao better.

records.jp: いったい何を考えてるのか、どうしてあんな風になったのか、<CR>ちゃんと理解したい
records.en_original: I want to know what she's thinking, why she's become the way she has. I want to understand her.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to understand what she's thinking and why she's become the way she has.
records.en: I want to know what she's thinking and why she became this way.<CR>I want to truly understand her.

records.jp: ただ、今のままじゃ絶対心を開いてくれそうにないから、<CR>正面からぶつかって麻央の懐に入りこむしかない
records.en_original: But at this rate, there's no chance she'll open up. Sp I've got to take her on personally in order to get to know her.
records.en_auxiliary: But at this rate, there's no chance she'll open up. So I've got to take her on personally in order to get to know her.
records.en: But as things stand, she'll never open her heart to me.<CR>I have no choice but to face her head-on and find a way past her defenses.

records.jp: でも、何も演技で勝負しなくたって！
records.en_original: But you didn't have to take her on in her own wheelhouse!
records.en_auxiliary: But you didn't have to take her on in her own wheelhouse!
records.en: But you didn't have to take her on in her own wheelhouse!

records.jp: 演技じゃなきゃだめなんだよ。<CR>それ以外の方法は……たぶんありえない
records.en_original: Yes I did. We have to compete as actors. I don't think there's any other way... It wouldn't work otherwise.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes I did. We have to compete as actors. I don't think there's any other way... It wouldn't work otherwise.
records.en: It has to be acting.<CR>There probably isn't any other way.

records.jp: （そう、麻央の中に見えた光はあれだけだったから）
records.en_original: (Because that was the only thing that shone inside Mao.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Because that was the single bit of light inside of Mao.)
records.en: (Because that was the only thing that shone inside Mao.)

records.jp: （すごく自然に、幸せそうに笑っていた）
records.en_original: (Her smile was so natural, so happy...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Her smile was so natural, so happy...)
records.en: (Her smile was so natural, so happy...)

records.jp: 大丈夫、私だってあっさり負ける気はないよ
records.en_original: Don't worry. I'm not going down without a fight.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. I'm not going down without a fight.
records.en: Don't worry. I'm not going down without a fight.

records.jp: みんなが応援して与えてくれた役だしね。<CR>絶対に勝ってみせるよ
records.en_original: Everyone cheered me on when they first gave me the lead role. I'll show them that their faith was justified.
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone cheered me on when they first gave me the lead role. I'll show them that their faith was justified.
records.en: Everyone supported me and entrusted me with this role.<CR>I'm going to win.

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: 来た……！
records.en_original: It's here...!
records.en_auxiliary: It's here!
records.en: It's here...!

records.jp: こんなに早く！？
records.en_original: Already!?
records.en_auxiliary: Already?!
records.en: Already!?

records.jp: さっきの歪みがすごかったから、<CR>引き寄せられてきたのかも
records.en_original: Maybe it was attracted to the distortion from earlier.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe it was attracted to the distortion from earlier.
records.en: Maybe it was drawn here<CR>by how powerful the earlier distortion was.

records.jp: どっちにしろ倒さなきゃいけないんだから、ちょうどいいよ。<CR>行こう！　二人とも！
records.en_original: We've got to fight it off either way! Let's go, both of you!
records.en_auxiliary: We've got to fight it off either way! Let's go!
records.en: Either way, we have to defeat it, so this is perfect timing.<CR>Let's go, you two!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Yeah!
